title: Spool batch exits without its template identifier
root_cause: The Rust program requires a nonempty ROSEWOOD_TEMPLATE_ID, but the workflow does not supply it. The program reports the missing value and the shell wrapper exits with a generic batch failure.

relevant_evidence.why: The missing setting is reported before the wrapper failure.
The program rejects an absent or empty template identifier.
The wrapper converts the program failure into a batch failure.
